sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Prem Sagar Verma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.

Heard Sri Prem Sagar Verma, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Kamlesh Kumar Tripathi,
learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking direction for expeditious disposal of Complaint Case No.6014 of 2020, CNR No.UPAG040416942020 (Narendra Kumar Bhojwani vs. Nirvesh Sharma) under Section 138 of the N.I. Act and under Section 420 IPC, Police Station-Kotwali, District-Agra, pending before the Presiding Officer, Additional Court No.3, Agra.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the instant case under Section 138 N.I. Act was filed on 14.9.2020 and since then, the matter is pending and the proceedings of the instant case Narendra Kumar Bhojwani vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5847203/
1 could not be concluded, whereas the proceedings under Section 138 of N.I. Act are expected to be concluded within six months in view of Section 143 (3) of the N.I. Act.

entities.text: Narendra Kumar Bhojwani vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, he has prayed for a direction for expeditious disposal of the aforesaid complaint case filed by the applicant herein.
4. Learned AGA for the State do not oppose the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant.

5. Looking at the facts and circumstances and the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant,
this Court do not find any good reason to issue notice to the opposite party No.2 and to keep the matter pending here, which will further delay the trial of the aforesaid case.
6.

In view thereof, the Presiding Officer, Additional Court No.3, Agra, is directed to consider and decide the aforesaid case filed by the applicant herein, expeditiously, preferably within a period of six months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, if there is no other legal impediment.
7. With the aforesaid directions, the instant application is disposed of.
